name: BoardsForCharcoal
description: Lets you build charcoal pits out of stacked planks (boards) instead of firewood. Stack planks on the ground exactly like firewood, build a small firewood kindling firepit on top, enclose it and light it - the plank stacks burn down into charcoal just like firewood. Planks of any wood work, and a single pit can mix wood types across blocks. Per-plank charcoal yield matches firewood.
